Northern Star Appoints Ex-Anglo American CEO, Former Orion MD to Board
Northern Star Resources said it appointed ex-Anglo American chief executive Mark Cutifani and former Orion Resource Partners managing partner Peter Rozenauers as independent nonexecutive directors.

The appointments, effective Oct. 1, follow "constructive discussions" with Elliott Investment Management, which in June announced a large stake in the Australian gold miner and urged the company to substantially enhance its board.
Last month, Elliott said it had lined up several potential new independent directors, including Cutifani and Rozenauers, as it reiterated a call for sweeping strategic and operational reviews.

Northern Star has grappled with operational challenges that have resulted in a number of guidance downgrades. Its struggles mean it hasn't been able to fully capitalize on strength in the gold price, which reached a record high earlier this year.
In July, the miner named the head of Glencore's nickel and zinc industrial assets, Suresh Vadnagra, to be its next chief executive, starting in October.

"We are very pleased that Mark and Peter have agreed to join our Board and I have no doubt that they will make a great contribution as we transition to new leadership under Suresh Vadnagra," Chairman Michael Chaney said Monday.
